---
title: "3 · Convolutional Networks"
code-tools: false
toc: false
---

CIFAR-10 with a flattened dense network, and what flattening throws away. Convolution, continuous and discrete, images with three channels, learnable kernels, stride, padding and pooling; convolutional networks on CIFAR-10 and their regularisation (L1 and L2 penalties, dropout, batch normalisation). Class activation maps and Grad-CAM show where a network looks; adversarial examples show how easily it is fooled.
